subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Circling back on my earlier email about funded-account acquisition in Ghana. Since MTN spun off its Ghana MoMo operations into a standalone fintech entity on 31 March 2026, your tier is being repriced as an independent growth unit, which sharpens cost discipline. A reported 50-dollar neobank CAC actually runs 85 to 105 dollars once KYC, deposit bonus, and card issuance load in (prospeo 2026), so the funded account protects payback. We measure paid funded accounts against a holdout, so they read as incremental to your organic depositors. Worth comparing against your source mix?
